notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
You have no other Drakes on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
The nontoken Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
